chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
“Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day”
then he should not enter the bathhouse except with a waistcloth.
And he, peace be upon him and his family, prohibited ghusl under the open sky except with a waistcloth, and he prohibited entering rivers except with a waistcloth.
So he said: “Indeed, the water has inhabitants and dwellers.”

key_terms.بِمِئْزَرٍ: with a waistcloth or covering around the waist

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about covering oneself in the bathhouse or while bathing?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to preserve modesty when entering the bathhouse, performing ghusl, or entering rivers, by using a waistcloth. It presents this etiquette as connected to faith in Allah and the Last Day, and emphasizes reverence and restraint in places associated with water.
